messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: apac-pool3 showing ECC oscillation pattern. 120 correctable errors in 5m, then drop to 5/min, repeating twice. cf: https://internal.metrics/apac-pool3 :warning:
sam: saw the alert, pulling logs + last 6h trend. :eyes:
lee: is this concentrated on a single card or spread across multiple GPUs in the pool?
maria: preliminary -> looks like 3 cards (card3, card7, card11) on node apac-node-44, errors come in bursts every ~10m.
ton y: that node runs low-latency serving for chat models — evacuating affects SLOs. want to avoid full pool shred.
sam: agree. propose conditional-evict: only cordon node, probe by requeueing low-priority jobs, not full drain unless error rate sustained > 10m at > 50 errs/min on any single card.
lee: +1. we should add hysteresis: require 2 consecutive windows (5m each) above threshold before hard-evict.
maria: also add soft-quarantine label so scheduler avoids bin-pack, but keep existing long-running in place until probe fails.
ton y: what's the rollback criteria? if errors drop after cordon, we revert within 30m?
sam: rollback if per-card errors < 5/min for 3 windows (15m) and no new Xid events.
lee: can we run a quick query to validate thresholds? ps:
```
SELECT card_id, SUM(errors) as err5m FROM ecc_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND pool='apac-pool3'
GROUP BY card_id ORDER BY err5m DESC;
```
results: card3=64, card7=38, card11=18 right now.
maria: card3 is the hot one. suggest scheduling a neighboreviction test on that node (dry-run) and run kernel-retry toggles.
ops-bot: @sam running dry-run eviction for node apac-node-44 (cmd: evict --node apac-node-44 --dry-run). Will post summary.
ops-bot: Dry-run summary: would have moved 12 pods, 3 pods would be rescheduled to other pools (capacity available). No model-serving critical pods flagged for mandatory-locality.
ton y: cost/impact check: moving 3 pods to eu-west will add ~120ms p90 for those requests during reshard; acceptable if temporary.
sam: decision: enact conditional cordon + soft-quarantine on apac-node-44 now. If card3 > 50/min for 10m or any Xid shows up, escalate to full drain and replace. Otherwise rollback after stability window.
maria: creating infra-ticket #INF-1973 to schedule replacement and to track post-mortem. Assigning to hw-ops and node-owner.
lee: will update the ECC-oscillation section of the runbook with hysteresis params: per-card threshold 50/min, require 2 windows before hard-evict, rollback after 3 windows of quiet.
ton y: tagging this thread for followup in weekly oncall sync. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and post updates.
ops-bot: NOTE: Incident flag set to "alerting-low". Will auto-close if no further spikes in 2h. :white_check_mark:
